inputs.objective: Independently validate the frozen Russell US reconstitution benchmark-flow mechanism using documentary and data-feasibility evidence only.

allowed_actions: read the frozen hypothesis and pinned Legacy ledger
verify primary FTSE Russell schedule and exchange implementation documents
assess point-in-time constituent and weight availability, benchmark-flow sizing inputs, auction mechanics, capacity, crowding and leakage risk
persist one EvidenceAssessment with PASS_TO_TEST_DESIGN, PARK_DATA or KILL_MECHANISM recommendation
success_condition: One independent documentary EvidenceAssessment determines whether the frozen candidate is test-design ready, data-blocked or structurally invalid without outcome access.
